user.title: Webasto Cool Top Trail
user.description: Pair the IR bridge with the built-in ESPHome integration first, then select it here. If the bridge has an IR receiver, press any button on the physical remote once to load the current settings. Without a receiver, controls start from default settings: off, cool, 24 °C, auto fan, display on, unlocked, Sleep and timers off; the first command you send applies that complete profile. IR provides no appliance feedback; room temperature is optional.
